title: Tampa Florida Scavenger Hunt Walking Tour
includes: Access to the interactive scavenger hunt and challenges you follow & find with your smartphone.
Please bring a fully charged smartphone with Internet connection (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on an engaging scavenger hunt through the historic streets of Tampa, Florida! Explore the quaint and beautiful historic downtown. See the historic sights like the Tampa Bay Hotel, Woolworth Sit In Site, Fort Brooke Cemetery, Tampa Riverwalk, and much more.

Explore and see the many unique shops, restaurants and sights. Go at your own pace and see the best of what Tampa has to offer. Ready to discover Tampa in a whole new way? Let the adventure begin!
